meta.tldr:
Aider 0.86.0 significantly expands its AI model compatibility, now fully supporting all GPT-5 models and integrating Grok-4 via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4`. This broadens the range of powerful AI backends developers can leverage for code generation and assistance. Additionally, support for `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17` and `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2` models has been added, offering more choices for specific use cases and preferences.

Command-line usability has been enhanced with `/clear` now providing a confirmation message "All chat history cleared." after execution, improving user feedback. The `/undo` command's output is now more concise, displaying only the first line of each commit message for better readability when reviewing changes. A new feature allows users to display model announcements by running the `/model` command without any arguments, keeping them informed about the latest AI capabilities.

Several important fixes are included in this release. An issue where new settings for an existing model failed to overwrite old configurations has been resolved, ensuring model settings are correctly applied. Analytics have been updated to be compatible with the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, improving data collection reliability. Furthermore, dependencies have been bumped to `litellm==1.75.0`, bringing in the latest upstream improvements and bug fixes. This release is recommended for all users to benefit from expanded model support, improved UX, and critical bug fixes.
